subject: Greenfield Health CAIQ: control inventory handoff & contract redline coordination
messages:
From: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
Cc: Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ intake and control-to-artifact mapping request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Greenfield Health's security team wants to move forward with a CAIQ-style exchange so we can validate a short list of controls for our upcoming procurement window. Specific asks from our side:

- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet (your latest answers)
- A control->artifact index that maps each asserted control to the corresponding runtime or policy artifact (logs, diagrams, runbooks). We need at least one concrete sample per critical control.
- Attachment samples for: (a) runtime isolation proof, (b) key rotation audit sample, (c) tenant data segregation checklist.
- Any standard redlines your legal team expects for our SOW (particularly data residency and SLA credit language).

Could you share the CAIQ spreadsheet and an evidence manifest by EOD Friday (we're in the middle of our procurement review). Also, we'd prefer DocuSign access for the cover SOW when the redlines are ready.

Thanks — let me know if you want to schedule a quick sync with our compliance engineers.

Rachel Adams
Security Program Manager, Greenfield Health
rachel.adams@greenfieldhealth.com

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@greenfieldhealth.com>, Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and control-to-artifact mapping request

Jonas / Marissa — looping you in to assemble the deliverables Rachel requested. Quick plan:

- Jonas: can you produce the runtime isolation diagram + a short log slice demonstrating tenant-boundary enforcement? Put both into a zip and label provenance (who pulled it / when). Target: EOD Thursday.
- Marissa: please prepare a short customer-facing note on key rotation (KMS/HSM flow) and attach a sample rotation log (redacted). Also confirm who from CS can do a 30-minute attestation call with Greenfield if they request it.
- I'll merge answers into our CAIQ master and create a control->artifact index CSV. I'll also start a legal thread for the SOW redline items — primary asks will be around data residency carveouts and SLA credit language.

Rachel / Procurement — we can hit EOD Friday for an initial package. Jonas and Marissa will be the artifact owners; I'll be the pack curator.

Attachments: "Redwood_CAIQ_response_v1.xlsx" (draft).

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions Security Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and control-to-artifact mapping request

Stephanie — quick update and attachments (will upload to the Drive link once we scrub PII):

- I exported a compact runtime isolation diagram (runtime-isolation-diagram.pdf). It shows: network segmentation, GPU tenancy boundaries, KVM/namespace mapping, and the KV-cache tenant tagging we use to prevent cross-tenant leakage.
- Provided a log slice (in evidence_manifest_stephanie_v1.zip) that demonstrates an automated eviction and eviction trace for a cross-tenant KV access attempt (this proves enforcement for CCM-RA-5 and CCM-SI-2 — see index).
- Notes on control mapping: for a handful of CSA control IDs where we rely on compensating controls (multi-tenant optimizations + runtime guardrails), I added short rationale paragraphs with links to instrumentation tests.

Questions for legal: Rachel called out SLA credits & data residency. Do we have a standard paragraph we can surface (we typically limit residency statements to region-specific deployed Private clusters; hosted API is multiregional by default). If they want a hard data-residency guarantee on hosted API, we'll need a Private deployment addendum.

Attaching: runtime-isolation-diagram.pdf (attached).

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
To: Rachel Adams <rachel.adams@greenfieldhealth.com>, Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-27T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ package delivery and next steps (DocuSign routing for SOW)

Rachel / Procurement team — attached is an initial CAIQ package for your intake review. This is intended to give you control-level assertions and representative artifacts rather than exhaustive production logs. If you need additional evidence samples we can expand the export window.

Package contents (attached):
- Redwood_CAIQ_response_v1.xlsx — completed answers with brief rationales and references to artifacts.
- evidence_manifest_stephanie_v1.zip — contains redacted log slices, rotation audit sample, and a short runbook snippet showing key rotation steps.
- runtime-isolation-diagram.pdf — concise architecture diagram with tenant separation callouts.

Legal & SOW redlines: our legal team is reviewing a couple of standard carve-ins for Private deployments (if you require strict data residency on hosted API, we'll need Private-deploy language). For SLA credits, we're proposing a tiered credit schedule in lieu of per-incident credits for the hosted offering; happy to have a call to walk through options.

DocuSign: I created a cover SOW with our proposed redlines — link: https://docusign.com/complete/0a1b2c3d4e. Please review and comment; if Procurement is ready, we can route for signature after one brief legal alignment call.

Next steps:
- Rachel: confirm whether this package is sufficient for initial procurement evaluation or if you need deeper production telemetry samples.
- Procurement: if you want to proceed to SOW, advise on signatories and any additional commercial redlines.
- Jonas / Marissa: please stand by for any follow-up artifact requests.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions Security Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
